24-1: No standalone AI gateway component. Equivalent functions are distributed: provider routing via ModelClientFactory; cost tracking via usage_cost.py:101; circuit breaking via CircuitBreakerRail (circuit_breaker_rail.py:1); content safety via GuardrailRail (guardrail_rail.py:1); observability via ObservabilityHandler (observability/event.py:1). These are per-agent, not cross-service. A separate gateway upstream of Jiuwen would handle cross-service key isolation and semantic caching.
